mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in annualized CPIAUCSL inflation rate compresses real interest rates and reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of monetary policy stance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL declines by at least 0.2% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% during late-cycle labor market tightness indicates accelerating wage growth and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0% and labor market is late-cycle, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through revenue expectation upgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the interaction term in a regression has negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, which precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises by at least 0.3% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 900,000 units signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 900, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) rising above 950,000 units during early-cycle housing recovery predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as housing-driven consumer spending accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 950 and housing market is in early-cycle, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL inflation and stable FEDFUNDS rate (within 0.1%) indicates transitory inflation without policy tightening, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% and FEDFUNDS remains stable, or the interaction term in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
